ground.text: Notice where your feet meet the floor.
Slow your exhale, and notice what your body does.
Notice where your body is being supported right now.
Notice the air on your skin.
Feel the weight of your body where it rests.
Let your shoulders drop, and notice what changes.

explore.text: Find where you feel this sensation most.
Notice how big the sensation is.
Notice where the sensation starts and where it ends.
Notice if the sensation is on the surface or deeper inside.
See if the sensation has a center.
Notice the edges of the sensation. Are they sharp or soft?
Notice the texture of the sensation.
Notice if the sensation feels tight.
Notice if the sensation is buzzing or humming.
Notice if the sensation feels hollow.
Notice if the sensation feels sharp.
Notice if the sensation is warm or cool.
See if the sensation has a color.
See if the sensation has a shape.
See if the sensation has weight.
Notice if the sensation is moving or still.
Notice if the sensation pulses.
Notice if the sensation has a rhythm.
Notice how strong the sensation is right now.
Notice what the sensation does as you breathe.
Find the quietest part of the sensation.
See if any part of the sensation feels neutral.
See if a word or an image comes for the sensation. Let it arrive on its own.
Check that word or image against the sensation. Does it fit, or is there a closer one?
If the sensation feels familiar, just notice that. You don't need to know why.

allow.text: See if you can make a little room around the sensation.
Let the sensation be here, just as it is.
Say hello to the sensation, the way you would greet someone who has just arrived.
Ask the sensation what it needs, and wait without forcing an answer.
Remember that other people are feeling sensations like this right now.
Let the sensation move through you like a wave.
Simply watch the sensation. There is nothing to fix.
